description: CMOS temperature sensor of the RFID-tag paper (Sec. D, Fig. 10: self-biased bias circuit, PTAT voltage generator with substrate PNPs, unbalanced differential amplifier, voltage output V_TEMP), sky130, 1.8 V. Test = the replay pack's DC temperature sweep 0..100 C (1 C steps), output unloaded, at the three corners the golden setup verifies (TT, FS, SF; FF and SS were excluded by the user). Targets = the replay pack's targets.json (paper Fig. 26 curves digitized; per-corner limits as given). Not targeted (as in the pack): sensor power (no paper value), FF / SS corners, post-layout curves. User decision 2026-11-12: validity gates are bypassed for task eligibility/feasibility; all performance constraints remain enforced. Diagnostics are not a gate pass or physical qualification.
